title: Programme d'action pour les médicaments et vaccins essentiels: projet de résolution proposé par le Président du Comité ad hoc et les Rapporteurs

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: A French-language draft Executive Board resolution from January 1984 on the Action Programme on Essential Drugs and Vaccines, thanking and approving the report of the Board's ad hoc Committee on Drug Policies. It recommends a resolution to the Thirty-seventh World Health Assembly that recalls resolution WHA35.27 and welcomes growing support from Member States, industry and close cooperation with UNICEF.

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Continues the French draft resolution on essential drugs, asking the Director-General to strengthen technical cooperation with countries and coordinate all participants in the programme. The proposed Assembly text urges Member States to adopt pharmaceutical policies in line with WHA35.27, asks regional committees to support and review national programmes, and asks the Executive Board to keep monitoring the programme.
